name: Packaging Concepts Inc.
old_description: We are a premier, all-in-one product packaging supplier, providing container solutions to customers since 1993. Headquartered in the Twin Cities, we proudly serve customers nationwide.
about:
Packaging Concepts Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Plymouth, Minnesota, a suburb of the Twin Cities. The company operates as a supplier of product packaging and container solutions, serving customers across the United States. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The firm describes itself as an all-in-one packaging supplier, focusing on container solutions for a range of products. Details about specific manufacturing processes, facility size, employee count, or annual volume are not publicly provided.

Packaging Concepts serves a national customer base, though the company does not list specific industries or named clients in its available literature. Its offering is positioned broadly for businesses requiring packaging containers.

The company emphasizes its long-standing presence since 1993 and its role as a single-source supplier for packaging needs, but does not articulate a distinct technical differentiator or founding mission beyond supplying containers.
type_evidence: We are a premier, all-in-one product packaging supplier, providing container solutions to customers since 1993.
